__NOTOC__
<code><nowiki>{{End special}}</nowiki></code> closes a division opened by a special-division template. It emits a single <code>&lt;/div&gt;</code> and nothing else.

== Usage ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Curiosity}}
Additional context.
{{End special}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Pair it with the matching opener:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Opener !! Use
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Curiosity}}</nowiki></code> || Curiosity box
|}

An opener without its closer leaves a <code>&lt;div&gt;</code> open: every following paragraph and heading ends up inside it.
